baseline.policy: Historical migration snapshots only. Fixed cn is the merge oracle; differences must be classified rather than changing cn to preserve old errors. Future tests read JSON without an old package dependency.

evidence.captureMethod: temporary Rust binary linked against freshly built rustify-components; invokes actual ButtonClass/variants! APIs and macros::merge. Capture program and old dependency are not retained in future tests.

apis.name: variants! types
apis.syntax: variants! {Name {base: literal, variants: {variant: {First: literal [, Arm: literal ...]}, size: {First: literal [, Arm: literal ...]}}}}
apis.usedBy: Button; TestBadge and Chip component forms recurse to this arm

apis.name: variants! variant-only types
apis.syntax: variants! {Name {base: literal, variants: {variant: {First: literal [, Arm: literal ...]}}}}
apis.usedBy: public macro arm; no in-repo expansion found
apis.migrationRequirement: existing_local_public_macro_arm; no production repository usage found

apis.name: variants! link component
apis.syntax: types syntax + component: {element: ident, link: true}

apis.name: IntoTailwindClass::with_class
apis.usedBy: Button and generated components; String and &str arguments in tests

apis.name: AsTailwindClass::as_class
apis.usedBy: old derive-generated Class implementation; not called by hand in repository

apis.name: Default + Clone + Copy
apis.usedBy: Signal defaults and generated components; first enum arm is default, including Chip Yes

apis.name: public generated methods
apis.syntax: Class::builder(), instance.into_builder(), builder.variant(), builder.size(), builder.build(), to_class(), with_class(), From<Class>, From<Builder>
apis.usedBy: public old derive outputs; no handwritten builder/to_class use found in repository
apis.migrationRequirement: builder_methods_unused_and_not_required_by_current_repository_usage; to_class/with_class are captured common class conversion APIs

apis.name: old public re-export
apis.usedBy: macro expansion resolves old traits and join/merge macros; exported transitively to consumers
